blocks.rationale: Jointly repair the unresolved dependency and its consequence. The applicability helper first checks the source-defined obligated actor, allowing a source-supported Volunteer/Receiving-Party mismatch to short-circuit before unavailable Representatives fields. The terminal then treats a computed express exception as permission, applies the general prohibition only to an actual third-party query, and does not reverse that prohibition into an employee-disclosure rule.
